description: 47 patches across Feeld, FolderSync, Hidrate Spark, Meetup, Met Office, Tinder, and X, plus universal PairIP license-check bypass, universal OneTrust consent-banner auto-reject, and universal MITM patches (trust user CAs + bypass OkHttp pinning). v1.3.0 ports Feeld (co.feeld) to 9.10.0 and adds: 'Bypass forced update (spoof app version)' (defeats the 'version not supported' wall by spoofing react-native-device-info's version high) and three java.net SDK-entry tracker kills — 'Disable Adapty tracking' (subscription SDK device-fingerprinting + ipify lookup), 'Disable Sentry telemetry' (crash reporting + Session Replay), and 'Disable Facebook tracking' (GraphRequest app-events/gatekeeper). Existing Feeld patches: 'Disable AppsFlyer tracking', 'Disable Braze tracking', 'Block tracking hosts (okhttp)', 'Unblur profile photos'. Purchase-breaking Tinder paywall patches, the umbrellas, and the native-PairIP-blocked X (12.4.1) patches are default-off.
